title: SOPBench: Evaluating Language Agents at Following Standard Operating Procedures and Constraints
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the ability of language agents to follow procedural workflows and constraints in customer service domains (e.g., Banking, DMV, Healthcare). While it addresses safety through 'procedural safeguards' and 'adversarial jailbreak' testing, it does not evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics as core components.
